The '''King''' is one of a group of seven [[NPC]]s that are located in the {{Zone|Royal Palace}} within the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}}. 

== Purpose ==
There are seven NPCs that can be King, and at any given time, only one of them is the King. The King changes at the the end of each SkyBlock Day (every 20 minutes real time). Speaking to the King for the first time will allow the player to start [[Commissions]]. Speaking to all seven different Kings during their reigns rewards the player with a {{Item|King Talisman}} and the {{ach|A Royal Meeting|ach=true}}. It is not possible to view which Kings the player has spoken to, but the player is told in chat how many different Kings they have spoken to each time they speak to a King that they haven't already spoken to. The seven NPCs always rotate counter-clockwise in their seats, which allows the order of the next Kings to be determined. The cycle is as follows:

* King Brammor
* King Emkam
* King Redros
* King Erren
* King Thormyr
* King Emmor
* King Grandan

== Trivia ==
* According to {{NPCSprite|Tornora}}, "There isn't much going on in our caves", so "Most of their time is spent trying to decide who's going to be the next king".
* {{NPCSprite|Queen Mismyla}} is the queen regardless of who the King is.
** Her dialogue implies that she isn't fond of any of them, though she appears to like some more than others.
